title: The Sage's Fealty
description: If one does not know the way through these passes they will surely suffer misfortune.

title: Fealty of the Man
description: The tribes of the Man were always upfront and loyal to a fault.

title: Loyalty of the Beasts
description: Once one understands beasts, they can control them.

title: Lord of the Five Valleys
description: All that you see before you... this is the land of the five valleys.

title: The Rattan Army
description: Never having been pierced, the rattan's armour can weather even the harshest of blows.

title: Fealty of the Fire People
description: These are the flames not so easily doused.

title: Fealty of Yang Feng
description: A keen mind is more deadly than any blade.

title: Fealty of Ahuinan
description: Skill at arms is a valuable trait for any tribal chief.

title: Fealty of Dongtuna
description: A generous nature and a fierce martial prowess make for an excellent warrior.

title: Fealty of Jiangyang
description: The land provides, maybe here more than anywhere else.

title: Fealty of Jianning
description: A stunning site to behold; proud and resplendent.

title: Fealty of Jiaozhi
description: To stack a stone, no matter how small, is its own defiant act of might.

title: Fealty of Jinhuansanjie
description: To fight despite hardship, and maintain a benevolent soul – this is true strength.

title: Fealty of Mangyachang
description: The charge of the Ox is beyond the power of any warrior.

title: Fealty of Tu An
description: A disordered mind is a ruinous thing; martial order is essential.

title: Fealty of Xi Ni
description: When every path and bush are known to you, the land itself becomes your spear and shield.

title: Fealty of Yongchang
description: Let they who find their footing on this violent earth inherit it.

title: Fealty of Yunnan
description: May true leadership still the once-placid lakes of this patient land.

title: Fealty of Zangke
description: Treat the land with love and respect and it will return such kindnesses to you tenfold.

title: Ritual of the Dragon
description: The dragon brings wealth, success and prosperity.

title: Ritual of the Eagle
description: From the glint of an eagle's eye it sees all the lands arrayed below it.

title: Ritual of the Elephant
description: Be like the elephant, who remembers all and learns from their past.

title: Ritual of the Fish
description: The water flows, and the fish flows with it, its destination never in doubt.

title: Ritual of the Goat
description: The goat never loses balance, and is sure-footed on even the greatest precipice.

title: Ritual of the Monkey
description: If it is intelligence you seek, you should observe the monkey, the most cunning of all creatures.

title: Ritual of the Ox
description: The ox toils hard in the field, and shows the value of dedication.

title: Ritual of the Tiger
description: Be invisible, like the tiger, who stalks its prey with practiced ease.
